LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASS: COLLECTIVE NOUNS/ REFLEXIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns, part of Strand 2 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do you emphasise that you did something on your own? 2. Which words do you use to refer to a group of things or animals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in texts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use collective nouns and reflexive pronouns in sentences correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. adopt the use of collective and reflexive pronouns during communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
